findings.text: the refusal branch appends a generator expression (refused.append(report for report in (report,))) so the refused list of dispatch_awaiting_reviews holds generator objects, not the report dicts its docstring describes, and any reader taking run_id or reason from it fails.
dispatch_awaiting_reviews is called nowhere in the tree, so the peer of the shipped sweep is dead code while recover repeats the same loop inline at :3682.

the only wiring that makes a scoring run dispatch its own review is covered by no test, because the four tests call dispatch_review_for_run directly, so a regression removing this list comprehension passes the gate.
the docstring cites plan provenance (the plan's own review of this node found) where the mechanism carries the reason on its own, which the repository comment rules forbid.

justifications.durability: the reflex's decisions are exercised by the four tests, but no test calls recover(), so deleting the wiring at reckon/crew/recovery.py:3682 would turn the feature off with the suite still green.
justifications.evidence: the four tests at tests/test_scoring_dispatches_its_review.py:189-283 assert every part of the done-when with the contained half first, the cohort delta is recorded with digits and log receipts (/tmp/base4.log 3 failed 191 passed at cabde677 against /tmp/head4.log 3 failed 195 passed at 799a4adc with identical failure ids), and I re-ran the module myself: 4 passed in 5.37s.
justifications.fit: the module's explanatory idiom is followed, but reckon/crew/recovery.py:388 reaches its own dispatch module through importlib.import_module where :389 imports from that module directly, and the docstring at :299 leans on plan provenance instead of the mechanism.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery.py:3682 launches the composed review dispatch for every scoring run and this very review run exists because of it, the source run's pointer recording review_dispatch status dispatched at 2026-09-18T16:28:15Z, but the launch rides the recover sweep rather than a run entering scoring, since ticker.py sits outside this node's fence.
justifications.scope_discipline: both commits stay inside the four declared write paths, reckon/crew/recovery.py and tests/test_scoring_dispatches_its_review.py in 799a4adc and the plan and its evidence record in b91600f3, with nothing else touched.
